front.name: Sage of Ancient Lore
clauses: Sage of Ancient Lore's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
When this creature enters, draw a card.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform this creature.

back.name: Werewolf of Ancient Hunger
clauses: Werewolf of Ancient Hunger's power and toughness are each equal to the total number of cards in all players' hands.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.
